mapper.select: select from litemall_cj_product where enriched_time is not null and deleted = 0 order by update_time desc limit #{limit}
select from litemall_cj_product where deleted = 0 order by update_time desc limit #{limit}
select id from litemall_goods where source = 'cj' and cj_pid = #{cjPid} and deleted = 0 limit 1
select id, cj_pid from litemall_goods where source = 'cj' and deleted = 0
select id from litemall_category where source = 'cj' and cj_category_id = #{cjCategoryId} and deleted = 0 limit 1
select id from litemall_category where source = 'cj' and `name` = #{name} and deleted = 0 limit 1

select id, `name`, keywords, `desc`, pid, icon_url, pic_url, `level`, sort_order, add_time, update_time, deleted, source, cj_category_id from litemall_category where cj_category_id = #{cjCategoryId} limit 1
select id, `name`, keywords, `desc`, pid, icon_url, pic_url, `level`, sort_order, add_time, update_time, deleted, source, cj_category_id from litemall_category where cj_category_id is not null
select id from litemall_brand where source = 'cj' and `name` = #{name} and deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update litemall_goods set listed_num = coalesce(#{listedNum}, listed_num), review_count = coalesce(#{reviewCount}, review_count), rating = coalesce(#{rating}, rating), add_time = coalesce(#{createTime}, add_time), update_time = now() where id = #{goodsId}
mapper.select: select distinct c.value_id from litemall_comment c join litemall_goods g on g.id = c.value_id where c.type = 0 and c.deleted = 0 and g.source != 'cj'
select goods_id from litemall_goods_product where cj_vid = #{cjVid} and deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update litemall_goods_product set `number` = #{number}, update_time = now() where cj_vid = #{cjVid} and deleted = 0
